places.name: Presidio Tunnel Tops & Panoramic Park
places.summary: Spectacular 14-acre national park with paved multi-use gentle grade trails, accessible picnic areas, gender-inclusive ADA restrooms, and Golden Gate overlooks.

entrances.name: Anza Esplanade Pathway
entrances.notes: Continuous stabilized crushed stone and concrete accessible trail.

places.imageAlt: Presidio Overlook of Golden Gate Bridge

places.name: Tech Innovation Hub & Maker Campus
places.summary: State of the art accessible maker space with zero-step threshold and electric wheelchair charging docks.

entrances.name: North Automated Entrance
entrances.notes: Automatic sliding sensor door with tactile paving approach.

places.name: State Central University · Main Campus
places.summary: Comprehensive universal access campus with gentle 1:12 non-slip ramps, dual automatic entrances, and ADA braille elevators across all 4 floors.

entrances.name: South Gate (Main Quad Entrance)
entrances.notes: Gradual textured concrete ramp with 34" brushed steel handrails, motion-activated double glass doors.

entrances.name: North Library Link
entrances.notes: Covered canopy approach directly connected to shuttle transit loop.

entrances.name: Historic Clock Tower Arch
entrances.notes: Barrier alert: 8 steep granite steps without adjacent ramp. Use South Gate 40m to the right.

places.imageAlt: Accessible university plaza with wide stone ramp and sliding automated entrance

places.name: Metropolitan General Hospital
places.summary: Full ADA & Universal Design hospital with zero-step street-level emergency & clinical drop-offs, power sliding doors, low-reach reception desks, and extra-wide gurney/wheelchair lifts.

entrances.name: Main Atrium Pavilion
entrances.notes: Flush transition with tactile ground indicators, automated revolving door with wheelchair bypass button.

entrances.name: Ambulatory Care West Wing
entrances.notes: Direct ramp from Blue Zone accessible parking bays with sheltered wheelchair recharge hub.

places.imageAlt: Hospital main entrance with level threshold and automatic sliding glass doors

places.name: Grandview Botanical Gardens & Park
places.summary: Paved perimeter walkways with all-abilities garden paths, accessible boardwalks over the koi pond, and adapted rest benches. Upper alpine ridge has steep gravel gradients.

entrances.name: Visitor Center Entrance
entrances.notes: Paved asphalt transition from 6 dedicated ADA accessible parking spots with audio visitor guide rental.

entrances.name: Pine Ridge Trailhead
entrances.notes: Barrier alert: Natural timber log steps. Wheelchair users should follow the Meadow Boardwalk route.

places.imageAlt: Accessible paved botanical park path with wooden guardrails and resting turnout

places.name: Civic Hall & City Public Library
places.summary: Historic municipal building modernized with an architect-designed glass wheelchair ramp on the East colonnade, dual braille elevators, and height-adjustable digital catalog desks.

entrances.name: East Colonnade Accessible Ramp
entrances.notes: Equipped with push-button automatic door opener and illuminated night pathway.

entrances.name: North Grand Steps
entrances.notes: Monumental steps with no lift on this facade. Direct signage leads visitors 25m right to East Colonnade.

places.imageAlt: Modernized civic building with seamless glass and stone accessible access ramp

places.name: Harbor Transit Center & Metro Hub
places.summary: Multimodal transit interchange with high-visibility tactile ground indicators, audible arrival chimes, gap-fillers for train boarding, and 4 oversized elevators to subway platforms.

entrances.name: Concourse Central Gate
entrances.notes: Wide accessible turnstiles (95cm width) with contactless card taps at 32" height.

places.imageAlt: Transit concourse with yellow tactile paving guidance and wide accessible faregates

places.name: Saffron Courtyard Bistro
places.summary: Level patio entrance, spacious table spacing allowing 36" power wheelchair navigation, and single-stall accessible restroom with grab bars. Mezzanine dining area is stair-access only.

entrances.name: Main Street Front Door
entrances.notes: Single push door with pull handle. Staff is seated near door to assist when requested.

places.imageAlt: Ground floor dining room with wide aisles between tables and flush threshold entrance

places.name: Heritage Arts Theater
places.summary: Historic theater built in 1928. Front facade has 12 steep stone steps with no ramp. Wheelchair access is currently available via side stage door with prior box office coordination.

entrances.name: Main Box Office Facade
entrances.notes: Significant barrier: 12 steep marble steps without ramp. No lift installed.

entrances.name: Stage Door Alley Access
entrances.notes: Requires ringing buzzer for theater staff escort into orchestra seating area.

places.imageAlt: Historic theater steps facade with reported architectural access barrier
